I added a `--verbose` flag to `scripts/sync.sh`. I haven't run the script, so it's untested.

With `--verbose` as the first argument, it prints `copied <file>` after each file it copies. Without the flag it behaves as before. Usage is `scripts/sync.sh --verbose <dest>`.

The flag is only recognised in the first position. `scripts/sync.sh <dest> --verbose` won't work.

The claude.ai Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive and context7 connectors need authorizing before they can be used. You can do that in your claude.ai connector settings. This task didn't need any of them.
